bridges.description: Establish that the specifically biblical God exists.
Argue that the biblical God is necessary for knowledge, logic, and intelligible experience.
Connect the proposed foundation to the triune God revealed in scripture.
Defend biblical descriptions through contextual and worldview-sensitive interpretation.
Ground moral judgment in God and defend divine judgment against harm-based objections.
Deny the existence of the specifically described God of the Bible.
Argue that incompatible biblical descriptions and deeds make the depicted being impossible.
Use allegedly failed prayer promises and absent miracles against the depicted God.
Challenge the inference from philosophical foundations to the biblical God and scripture.
Use harm minimization to criticize biblical commands and actions.
